title: Esrbespoke parallax frame
description: A cropped media frame whose picture drifts at a different speed from the page as it scrolls by (scrubbed parallax), optionally fading in as it enters or rising 16px on load. Empty, it is a plain muted placeholder of the frame's size.
notes: the frame takes its size from className (h-svh, aspect-[4/3]…); the media fills it like object-fit: cover
parallax is CSS scroll-driven (view timeline) inside @supports; elsewhere the picture simply sits still
